The code should create three internet exchanges and multiple stub autonomous systems that join these exchanges. It should also create two autonomous systems with routers that join different networks and internet exchanges. The code should define private peerings between different autonomous systems. Finally, it should add a BGP attacker component that hijacks certain prefixes and joins an internet exchange. The code should merge the BGP attacker with the emulator and render the new emulator. The code should compile the new emulator using Docker and output the result to a specified directory.

```python
from seed_emulator import (
    Emulator, Layer, BaseSystem, Routing, Ebgp, Ibgp, Ospf, WebService,
    createInternetExchange, createNetwork, createAutonomousSystem, createRouter, createHost,
    joinNetwork, joinInternetExchange, addPrivatePeering, BgpAttackerComponent, merge,
    render, compile, Docker
)

def create_stub_as(asn, ix, net):
    # Create stub AS
    stub_as = createAutonomousSystem(asn=asn)
    # Create router and web server
    router = createRouter(name=f"r{asn}", asn=asn)
    web = createHost(name=f"web{asn}")
    # Add router and web server to AS
    stub_as.addVertex(router)
    stub_as.addVertex(web)
    # Join router to network and IX
    joinNetwork(router, net)
    joinInternetExchange(router, ix)
    # Connect web server to router
    joinNetwork(web, net)
    return stub_as

# Create emulator and layers
emu = Emulator()
emu.addLayer(Layer(BaseSystem))
emu.addLayer(Layer(Routing))
emu.addLayer(Layer(Ebgp))
emu.addLayer(Layer(Ibgp))
emu.addLayer(Layer(Ospf))
emu.addLayer(Layer(WebService))

# Create three internet exchanges
ix1 = createInternetExchange(name="ix1")
ix2 = createInternetExchange(name="ix2")
ix3 = createInternetExchange(name="ix3")
emu.addVertex(ix1)
emu.addVertex(ix2)
emu.addVertex(ix3)

# Create networks for stubs
net1 = createNetwork(name="net1", prefix="10.1.0.0/24")
net2 = createNetwork(name="net2", prefix="10.2.0.0/24")
net3 = createNetwork(name="net3", prefix="10.3.0.0/24")
emu.addVertex(net1)
emu.addVertex(net2)
emu.addVertex(net3)

# Create multiple stub ASes and join to IXes
stub_as1 = create_stub_as(65001, ix1, net1)
stub_as2 = create_stub_as(65002, ix2, net2)
stub_as3 = create_stub_as(65003, ix3, net3)
stub_as4 = create_stub_as(65004, ix1, net2)
stub_as5 = create_stub_as(65005, ix2, net3)
emu.addVertex(stub_as1)
emu.addVertex(stub_as2)
emu.addVertex(stub_as3)
emu.addVertex(stub_as4)
emu.addVertex(stub_as5)

# Create two core ASes with routers joining different networks and IXes
core_as1 = createAutonomousSystem(asn=65100)
core_r1 = createRouter(name="core1r1", asn=65100)
core_r2 = createRouter(name="core1r2", asn=65100)
joinNetwork(core_r1, net1)
joinNetwork(core_r2, net2)
joinInternetExchange(core_r1, ix1)
joinInternetExchange(core_r2, ix2)
core_as1.addVertex(core_r1)
core_as1.addVertex(core_r2)
emu.addVertex(core_as1)

core_as2 = createAutonomousSystem(asn=65101)
core_r3 = createRouter(name="core2r1", asn=65101)
core_r4 = createRouter(name="core2r2", asn=65101)
joinNetwork(core_r3, net2)
joinNetwork(core_r4, net3)
joinInternetExchange(core_r3, ix2)
joinInternetExchange(core_r4, ix3)
core_as2.addVertex(core_r3)
core_as2.addVertex(core_r4)
emu.addVertex(core_as2)

# Define private peerings between different ASes
addPrivatePeering(core_r1, core_r3)
addPrivatePeering(core_r2, core_r4)
addPrivatePeering(core_r1, core_r4)

# Add BGP attacker component that hijacks certain prefixes and joins an IX
bgp_attacker = BgpAttackerComponent(
    asn=66666,
    hijacked_prefixes=["10.1.0.0/24", "10.3.0.0/24"]
)
attacker_router = createRouter(name="attacker", asn=66666)
joinInternetExchange(attacker_router, ix1)
bgp_attacker.addVertex(attacker_router)

# Merge BGP attacker with emulator
emu = merge(emu, bgp_attacker)

# Render and compile the emulator using Docker, output to ./output
rendered_emu = render(emu)
compile(rendered_emu, Docker, output_dir="./output")
```
